name: Merritt Reservoir SRA - Willow Cove Campground
Calamus Reservoir SRA - Valley View Flat Campground
Swanson Reservoir SRA - Lake View loop
why: Not a separate place: ReserveAmerica park 234151 loop LAKE VIEW (read 2026-11-05) puts its 8 sites (045-052, GIS centroid 40.15086,-101.06823) 0.48 km from the nearest Spring Canyon site (042) and 0.72 km from Spring Canyon's site centroid, on a short spur off the same SRA access road that serves Spring Canyon (Esri World Imagery, rendered 2026-11-05) - under the ~1 km / own-entrance bar, so it is covered by 2741 Swanson Reservoir SRA - Spring Canyon Campground (whose pin is only 0.43 km away).

name: Miller Creek - Lewis and Clark SRA
Willow Springs RV Park & Campground
why: Private park with no operator website, no booking page and no RV Life listing: only directory records (AAA 'call for rates', The Dyrt unclaimed/not bookable, 1 review 2025-05, priceLow $0), and Google Maps (gm.py 2026-11-05) shows 4.2 from 12 reviews, phone 308-750-1364, no website - under the 25-review floor, so neither the price nor the presence indicator is met (curation doc private rule, AWH 2026-10-14). MHVillage lists the same address (46854 Willow Springs Rd) as 'Willow Springs Mobile Home Park', and Esri imagery at 41.7814,-99.0985 (300 m frame, rendered, 2026-11-05) shows a small tree-shaded cluster of parked trailers/RVs and mobile homes - a likely long-stay park as well.

name: Calamus Lodge Campground (now Calamus Motel & RV)
kind_of_no: long-stay park (nights not really for sale)
why: Mostly annual-lease park failing long-stay test 2 and with no price indicator: the operator's last readable page (calamuslodge.com/campground.php, Wayback 2026-05-08) says '25 long-term shaded camp sites ... only rented annually' (status FULL, 'call to join the waiting list'), plus '6 short-term campsites which have a 2-night minimum stay' with water and electric, status not shown, 'Please call for price' - no posted nightly rate, no booking site, no RV Life listing (Algolia park index, 2026-11-05) and not in the Good Sam directory. calamuslodge.com now redirects to an unrelated apartments site (commercialsquareapartments.com, 2026-11-05); Google Maps names the business Calamus Motel & RV, LLC (4.6 from 57 reviews, 308-346-4331) with a new site calamusmotelandrv.com that refused every automated read (Cloudflare 403 / 'Too Many Requests', 2026-11-05). On the fence + mostly seasonal + iffy = drop (AWH 2026-10-31).

name: Dad's Calamus East
why: Private: a fuel station / convenience store (Dad's Calamus East, 220 N 13th Ave) with seven full-hookup camper sites on the east side of its lot (land.com / LoopNet / AcreValue sale listings, read 2026-11-05) - no operator website, no booking page, no RV Life or Good Sam listing, no posted rate; Google Maps (gm.py 2026-11-05) 4.1 from 16 reviews, phone 308-346-5567, no website - under the 25-review floor, so neither the price nor the presence indicator is met (curation doc private rule, AWH 2026-10-14). The only listing that names it as camping is the City of Burwell camping page (name + phone only).
